sentences.en: An integer is natural iff it is greater than or equal to 0.
sentences.zh: 一个整数是自然数当且仅当它大于或等于0。

sentences.en: Every positive integer has exactly one successor.
sentences.zh: 每一个正整数恰好有一个后继者。

sentences.en: An integer is natural if and only if it is greater or equal to 0.
sentences.zh: 一个整数是自然数当且仅当它大于或等于0。
